title: Tilted axes on a frictionless incline
caption: With one axis along the slope the weight splits in two: along the slope mg sin 30° gives a = g sin 30° = 4.9 m s⁻²; perpendicular, N = mg cos 30° (8.49 N per kg) and there is no acceleration. Only weight and the normal force act.
alt: Free-body diagram for 1 kilogram on a frictionless 30 degree slope: weight down, normal force perpendicular to the slope, net force down the slope.
description: Weight 9.8 N per kg, straight down; normal force 8.49 N perpendicular to the slope.
Net force 4.9 N down the slope, so a = g sin 30° = 4.9 m s⁻².
